name: Mateo Hernández
title: Full Stack Developer
headline: React · Node.js · TypeScript · Firebase · Multi-tenant SaaS in production

contact.location: Cali, Colombia (UTC-5) · Open to remote work

profile: Full Stack Developer with 3+ years building business software with JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Node.js. Currently the lead developer of a multi-tenant SaaS for restaurants (point of sale, order management and online menu) running in production for 12 companies and 18 locations. I start from the business problem: I gather requirements with the client, model the data and rules, build with automated tests and document every decision. Experience in data migration, performance, multi-tenant security and AI-assisted development.

bullets: Lead developer of a multi-tenant SaaS for restaurants (POS, order management, online menu, product landing pages and admin console) built with React, Node.js/Express and Firebase, in production for 12 companies and 18 locations; authored 96% of the commits since August 2026 (408 of 424).
Extended and maintain the POS REST API (316 endpoints: cash register and reconciliation, purchases with taxes, inventory by location, production and reports) with about 1,600 automated test cases.
Designed a reusable data importer (generic engine, per-source adapter, preview and rollback) and migrated a client from VectorPOS: 1,703 customer, supplier and recipe records in about 21 minutes.
Integrated the online menu, OMS and POS through a versioned order contract with transactions and idempotent IDs that prevent duplicate sales, plus customer notifications via WhatsApp templates.
Cut sale checkout time by about 50% (from 1,390 ms to ~700 ms) by batch-loading recipes from Firestore; validated against 2,470 orders.

Built an internal console in 9 days to onboard companies and enable their apps (170+ tests) and implemented multi-tenant authentication with Firebase custom tokens, scrypt password hashing and login rate limiting.
Documented the product (79 technical documents, 44 business rules, architecture decision records and phased roadmaps) and work with AI (Claude Code) from specs and acceptance criteria.
Designed and built VetPOS, a point of sale and veterinary management platform ready for multiple clinics, with NestJS, TypeORM, MySQL, React, TypeScript and Docker Compose.
Built 12 backend modules: sales, inventory with stock movements, customers, pets, appointments, services, expenses and Excel reports.
Implemented JWT authentication with three roles (super admin, admin and employee), security headers and request rate limiting.

Built Mini Programs (AXML, ACSS and JavaScript) for Claro's super app: Cinemark Preferencial (second-largest contributor to the repository) and the Templo de la Moda checkout flow (cart, payment summary and shipping details).
Built the plan and service sales flow of Claro's Sales App in Next.js 16, React 19 and Tailwind CSS: catalog, plan review and admin views.
Acted as the link between clients and the technical team: turned business needs into requirements and supported functional testing through QA.
Technical lead of the Relatoría project for Colombia's Office of the Inspector General (Procuraduría General de la Nación), coordinating team activities and deliverable quality.
Built business solutions with JavaScript, React, Next.js and SQL Server on the Lappiz platform to automate business processes.
Gathered requirements with government agencies and corporate clients, and designed databases for critical processes.
Built Power BI dashboards and automated document generation with jsPDF, working with Scrum, Azure DevOps and Git.
Built proofs of concept for clients across industries with JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap and Kendo UI, backed by SQL Server databases and Power BI reports.
